title: Abagoberezi abeeyama
intro: Nnabbi eyali assaamu ekitiibwa yatambulira mu bantu, ng’abayita okugenda mu mazima. Bangi baakyuka mu bukakanyavu, naye akabinja akatono akaali kamwewaddeyo ne kaddamu omulanga ne beeyama n’omutima gwabwe gwonna. Baagezesebwa n’okubuusabuusa era ne baguma okunoonya eby’okulya eby’omu ggulu. Okwewaayo kwabwe okutasalako kwafuuka eky’okuyiga ekitaggwaawo mu kukkiriza. Baali baani?
clues: Twali kibinja kitono ekyasituka okuwagira obutume obw’obwakatonda mu kiseera eky’obutakkiriza bwa bantu bangi.
Nabbi ow’ekitiibwa yajja n’atukoowoola okuyimirira ng’emikwano mu kkubo lya Allah.
Nabbi bwe yabuuza ani agenda okubeera abawagizi b’Obwakatonda, twaddamu awatali kulonzalonza.
Twaguma okusaba ekijjulo eky’ekyamagero ekyasindikibwa okuva mu ggulu okunyweza emitima gyaffe.
Nabbi waffe yatujjukiza okussa ekitiibwa mu Allah singa tuli bakkiriza abatuufu, naye ate okusaba kwaffe okw’obwetoowaze kwassibwamu ekitiibwa.
Ffe twali nkulungo ey’omunda eyeewaddeyo eyasuubiza okukkiriza okutakyukakyuka ku mabbali ga Isa, mutabani wa Maryam.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
